description: Displayed marked 36-8535 which is the serial of the first F-104J flown into Nyutabaru on 14 Nov 1963; the real 36-8535 is at Matsushima
Displayed clean with no tanks or inboard pylons like the Chitose and Naha aircraft
The last T-2 built; struck off at Tsuiki 11 May 2006; repainted in aggressor-style colours and marked 69-5127 after an aircraft that actually served with the Nyutabaru aggressor unit
The second T-6G displayed here after 72-0178 was scrapped around 2000
Rescue variant retained as a base display
